title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts | TechCrunch
summary: OpenAI’s new Astra model will use a reasoning technique called “recurrent depth” that allows it to operate outside of the sequential thinking that characterizes most reasoning models, The Information reported on Tuesday.
